sources.title: Visa policy index
sources.publisher: Department of Immigration and Passports, Government of Bangladesh
sources.officialityEvidence: The Department of Immigration and Passports publishes this policy index on dip.gov.bd and labels its VOA entry as updated 15 July 2024. The index did not complete a direct browser fetch at cross-review, so it is not treated as an independently current nationality schedule.

sources.title: Visa on Arrival
sources.publisher: Embassy of the People’s Republic of Bangladesh, Copenhagen
sources.officialityEvidence: This Bangladesh embassy guidance is published on the official mofa.gov.bd domain and states it was updated 25 February 2025. At cross-review it returned a 502 response, and its undefined regional phrase is not treated as an exact current passport-code schedule.
sources.supportingExcerpt: all European Countries are eligible for Visa on Arrival

sources.officialityEvidence: The footer identifies the Department of Immigration & Passports and Government of Bangladesh.
